description_en: A rigid shallow rectangular woven clutch with a wood inner tray that slides sideways and short leather wrist strap. Canonical front: a woven rectangular face with a small pull at one edge. Side view: the visible tray rail and leather wrist-loop anchor. Rear view: a flat woven face with the outer sleeve seam. All panels, linings, hardware and inserts are completely unmarked; no text, logos, symbols or labels. Keep the identical structure, materials and attachments across all three views.
prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE original photorealistic Vietnamese rattan/bamboo studio catalog product. Subject: A rigid shallow rectangular woven clutch with a wood inner tray that slides sideways and short leather wrist strap. Canonical front: a woven rectangular face with a small pull at one edge. Side view: the visible tray rail and leather wrist-loop anchor. Rear view: a flat woven face with the outer sleeve seam. All panels, linings, hardware and inserts are completely unmarked; no text, logos, symbols or labels. Keep the identical structure, materials and attachments across all three views.. Style Boho: organic graceful curves and restrained craft detail. Relative size compact within its class, no measurements. Main woven surfaces: regular open hexagonal cane lattice with three strip directions. Finish: cinnabar red lacquer retaining clearly visible woven strip intersections. Believable smooth bindings, continuous strips, stable wood/bamboo frame and only specified plain secondary materials. All interiors empty. CAMERA: exact straight-on FRONT ELEVATION at azimuth zero, directly facing its described front feature, level with product center. No three-quarter or overhead angle. This is the canonical FRONT image for subsequent views of the same design. Whole object visible, centered with generous margins. Plain warm-white seamless studio backdrop, soft lighting and subtle shadow, sharp fiber texture. Square image. No props, room, people, animals, food, plants, detached extra products, collage, diagram or border. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT ANYWHERE: no letters, numbers, words, symbols, labels, logos, captions, watermarks, measurements or inscriptions.

visual_review.method: manual comparison of canonical front and three-view review sheet
